# Draft:The Treaty of Naumburg

The Treaty of Naumburg was an agreement concluded between the two branches of the Wettin dynasty of Saxony, the Ernestines and the Albertines, following the political changes after the Schmalkaldic War and the Albertine acquisition of electoral authority in 1547.
The treaty confirmed and adjusted the division of Saxon territories between the Ernestine and Albertine lines and recognised their respective holdings. It formalised the political separation of the two branches of the dynasty and reaffirmed the settlement reached after 1547.
The agreement contributed to reducing tensions between the Ernestine and Albertine branches and helped stabilise the political situation in central Saxony in the following years.
